text: Love love love this place!  Fast and friendly service and the food is delicious!  Anything I've ordered there has been so flavorful and filling. Highly recommend Taqueria Olvera.

I've been here several times and I have to say I'm surprised by the bad reviews! Every time I order whether carry out or delivery the food has been way more fresh than any other Chinese food in the area (looking at you, J&I) and well spiced. The crab Rangoon is nothing to write home about but the drunken noodles and egg rolls are both amazing and the portions have always been enough to get me three good sized meals at a bargain. Had a long wait time once years ago but otherwise they have been fast and friendly. This is still my go to Chinese restaurant!

If you read some of the reviews you may be swayed not to go. I wasn't swayed because I wanted to find out for myself. 
We got there around 9:3am on a Saturday morning and were seated right away (inside). 
Now let's no forget it's a pandemic so we should expect restaurants to have limited seating and longer wait times. But we had none of this. 
Here are the 3 meals we ordered. It's Peachy Waffle, Maple Cream Bacon Waffle and Creole Grits with Shrimp. The pictures don't do it any justice. The food is made fresh so we didn't mind waiting but I know we didn't wait long like some reviews stated. I don't mind waiting when I know my food is coming out fresh and flavorful. The service was A-1. Our waitress was very attentive and I will be raving and bragging about this place. Can't wait to go back
So sweet and delicious. Thai beef salad was like a dessert. And the coconut soup was strong too.

I have been coming there many times and each time they treat you like they are doing you a favor , they are always rude and now they are serving margaritas to go they don't tell you the price and then charge you 25 on your credit card before you can do anything, also tried to order food to go and they told that was too much food, that is degrading , I will be going on Facebook and calling the better business bureau to report them

Umberto's  is a very small restaurant that packs a punch. A lot of authentic, flavorful dishes to choose from. The interior is a little dated, but I encourage you to dine in just so you can see what everyone is ordering. We discovered the Snowballs which are now our absolute favorites. We ordered take-out several times during Quarantine. Each time, staff was completely Covid compliant. Every dish was packaged very nicely and each item was very fresh.

It was a pleasant September evening. I was feeling the itch for some good boneless wings and decided to give this place a shot based on the pictures. Well the wings were quite possibly the worst I have ever eaten (and I eat buffalo wings frequently). They were either overcooked or stale or something because they were chewy and rubbery, inedible in my opinion. Needless to say will not be going here for boneless wings again. Very disappointed.

Went to the soft opening and boy were we blown away. The cocktails were amazing, fresh and extremely creative. The food however was the absolute showstopper! Absolutely delicious!!! Keep up the good work and y'all will have a line around the block. Service from Alex and the rest of the team was top notch. Thanks again and cheers!

So the pictures drew me in but I don't think I will be back. My sister and I ordered 2 separate orders at 5:10pm. I got the general tso's salmon, and lemon pepper wings. She at first ordered a honey jerk chicken bowl, was told they were out of them. So she settled for general tso's shrimp and teriyaki wings. We were told our totals and that we would get a call when it was done....a call???Hmm ok. We went across town. Pulled up front...and sat...and sat..and sat....we called to let them know we were out front and were told they were still working on our meals....at 6:29 pm as we were slowly fading away to dust. We got a call to say our food was ready. Praise Him! I went to the door to pay (damn u Covid) and had to give my cards at the door. Was asked if it was together I said no one at a time. The door lady comes back and says oh shoot. I said what, she said I charged both of the meals on one card. She said I will just refund the one. I was like ok cool. Took my food to sis in the car, go back and here comes the door lady saying oh my manager is not here to refund it....by this time I was pissed and hungry so I said whatever and left, Even though the meals were slightly different in price. We get to our hotel. Yes we were in town visiting, and started to eat. Looked great! Looks can be deceiving. So the salmon was excellent. It took me a while to find it, since it was buried in slightly sautéed peppers and onions. If I was home I would have thrown them back in the frying pan f

Manakeesh is kind of a powerhouse - they have a great restaurant that offers awesome Mediterranean and Arab food with generous portions for decent prices. The dining system can be a bit confusing and sometimes you can feel like you are left hanging, but the food is honestly worth it. They make their pitas freshman and they are delicious, soft, and warm. The attached bakery is really cute and offers smoothies, great baklava and other desserts, as well as an amazing house blend tea!

La Margarita is a favorite mexican restaurant for me and located in such a great spot in Fountain Square. Who doesn't want to see "you are beautiful" as you walk into a mexican restaurant where nobody can diet or turn down chips and salsa?

My personal favorite there is the chorizo tacos. The helpings are huge so you can share and devour on chips or definitely try the heaping serving of guacamole.

They have a variety of margaritas and they are all tasty. I recommend going when it's warm and sitting outside. You can't beat the view. Of course inside is just fine in the winter time. There's never a bad time to eat tacos!
Love this place. Very COVID friendly. Try the tomato jam French fries.   We love the burgers as well

The pizza was cold, and I felt like it was rushed. I live five minutes from the shop and there's no reason for my pizza cheese to be completely unmelted. This place was recommended to me but I won't be returning. Seriously would have been better off if I went to a dominos or something, that's how unimpressed I was.

The Groveland Grill on RT. 611 in Pipersville ,PA, is a small roadside kitchen specializing in breakfast and lunch. It sits in a small commercial strip and is easy to miss if driving at normal speeds. I actually had to turn around and go back to it as I went north and didn't spy it until I was passed the driveway into their parking lot. 

The house is clean, with about ten tables and a counter with seven stools. The folks working there are very friendly, and welcomed this first timer with warm greetings. I took a seat at the counter across from the Bunn O Matic where Ellis coffee was being brewed. There was a dark blue ceramic mug with side stainless of milk in front of me in seconds, and a two page breakfast menu placed before me before I reached the counter. These people were on their game. 

There was a list of omelettes, benedicts, pancakes/French toast, and combo platters, but I decided on a standard breakfast sandwich of sausage, egg and cheese on kaiser. The side of home fries with grilled pepper and onion bits was also too tempting to pass up. 

The sammy was doubled up, making for a fat and filling meal in its own right. The taters were alright, but despite the flavor from the sauteed onion/pepper, the tubers themselves were a bit dry like they had been sitting on the corner of the grill too long. Maybe my arrival at 10:00 had some to do with that, but a word to the wise...

Loved the Ellis java, which was refilled as often as I desired. 

Groveland Grill is definite

Went here the first time because a dear friend mine got me a gift card. I've been back several times since- Lattes are the best, and I love the pistachio scone! I enjoy looking at all the artwork on the walls that's for sale, and would love to buy a piece some day.
Awesome food! Always changing the menu and creating new dishes. Will definitely be back.

I do love going to this location as it was recommended by my family. Food is really good but today, we're very disappointed because it took almost an hour for us to have our ordered food ready. If we didn't follow it up to the counter we wouldn't have our food till they closed at 2pm. At this time, they were unorganized even though there's enough manpower.  The owner/manager is really nice and just needs to make sure new employees are always trained to standard.

We ordered this the other night totally last minute and it was the best pizza I've had in Fl ever. Hands down. The garlic knots were killer, and the crust was the perfect crispiness. This is hands down our new fave place to get a pizza. This northern girl is happy!!!!

Love going for eat all you can Sushi night on Mondays. Absolutely worth going for that. Getting regular take out is not always so good. Sometimes it's great, sometimes it isn't, there seems to be a lack of consistency in the same dish only a week between orders. I used to love the spare ribs but I got them yesterday and they were quite dry and not anywhere near as good as they used to be.

Came here for brunch on a Saturday with a friend--there was zero wait for a table for 2. Menu consisted of a varied mix of options including Cuban, Argentinian, Colombian, etc. type of breakfasts... most of which were different takes on eggs with some kind of meat. The food is delicious and a nice change of pace from standard brunch fare. Staff is attentive and friendly too. Definitely recommend!

I wanted to give this 2.5 stars.  Well, I couldn't just give them that, but being on the fence and instead of dropping it to a 2, I bumped it up to a 3.  The food was actually delicious, but the portion size of the burger was a joke. I'm 5'7" and 145lbs, and I don't take large bites, but look at the photo I posted, that's just one bite.

I'd driven by a number of times since they started construction of this establishment a couple years ago and the other day I was in the area around lunch time and finally decided to give them a try.   So I pulled in and decided to dine inside.  The place is nice and clean, blah blah, to me only the food really matters.

I ordered the Garlic Burger with fries and a strawberry milkshake.  The burger had a nice fluffy bun that was lightly toasted, the garlic sauce / spread / liquid soaked into the bottom bun tasted really good.  It all combined with the pepperjack and was quite tasty. It was a little too salty but not enough that it was a distraction.  The distraction was the portion size.  It seemed smaller than a McDonalds 99c double cheeseburger.  Except for the bun.  And it tasted a whole lot better. 

The thin fries were pretty good for being fried with vegetable oil.  Sliced nice and thin some of them were crispy.  Some of the garlic sauce soaked into them and made finishing them easy.  The serving size was alright, but I rarely finish french fries so this wasn't really an issue.  I actually would have liked a little more because the burge

This place is jumping, as soon as you walk in you can feel the energized atmosphere.  The room is set up so you que around the outside walls, which is smart.  The staff was friendly and they deliver the food to you after you pay, which is nice.

What we ordered:

3 Jumbo Tender meal $9.99(no heat)
**On my first time at any place that serves "Nashville hot" chicken I always get the good without the spice. Because if they can make food taste good then the spice is just an afterthought.  The strips were juicy and full of flavor.  The portions are large enough for you to have leftovers of your not starving.

Leg Quarter meal $7.49
**Both meals are served on a piece of toast to soak up the extra spice and sauce.  With the leg quarter meal we got greens as a side. They were ok though on the salty side, which I like, my companion did not. So that's all in what you're use too.

All and all I say this is a place I will try again. Next time with the extra flavors!!

Pics attached, enjoy.

Years ago, I vowed never to step foot in this place again after a horrible situation. My family begged me for pizza for dinner tonight, and I gave in. I called in our order, and was told it would be 20 minutes. We showed up 25 minutes later, only to find that the two workers at the front never turned in the slip. Instead of apologizing, they argued with each other over who messed up. They worked quickly to fulfill my order, and the person that handed me the pizza apologized and told me to grab a soda to go. I was completely understanding of the situation. I got home to find my pizza wasn't completely cooked and all of the cheese slid off. The grease bled through the box and was all over my car. Needless to say, we will continue making the trek to 16th and Oregon the next time we want City Pizza.

I had a reservation for 7pm on a Tuesday. My boyfriend and I walked in, there was no one to greet us, no hostess, we stood there awkwardly for about 10 minutes when someone came upstairs and asked if we were being helped and i of course say no. Our waitress was rude, she didn't wear proper uniform. For a restaurant as high end as this, i would assume to have trained waiters and not just family friends to help out or something. We ordered our food, received soup + salad after 15 minutes, then 10 minutes after the waitress came to ask our appetizer again. The service was SOOOO bad. We ended up taking dessert to go because we had spent two hours in that restaurant waiting. We had to flag a waiter for more water. We got calamari which was bland. The rude young lady brought my boyfriend brown rice even though she never asked what kind of rice he wanted, but he took it anyways because we would have had to wait probably 15 minutes for a different rice. CHOOSE A DIFFERENT RESTAURANT unless you're prepared to spend roughly 2-3 hours here.

C&C Creamery has met and gone beyond my expectations! Had to find a new ice cream shop since my local one went down the drain so I went a bit out my neighborhood to find this one. There is a parking lot !! BONUS ! Upon arrival the line was a bit shorter than it usually is when I drive by which was great because I was anxious to get my hands on some ice cream!! The menu was extensive (but not overwhelming) it had a great mix of your regular ice creams and some fun mixes too. There was water ice, soft serve, hard ice cream, frozen yogurt, sugar free ice cream, low fat .. oh man I could keep going! My eyes were caught by the dip cone sign. I haven't had a dip cone since I was a child! It brought back memories and I had to get one. I got a small cherry flavor covered dip cone with vanilla soft serve and it was just like I used to have 15 years ago as a kid going to ice cream with my grandparent. My boyfriend got the cookies and cream (which I'm not surprised because I've never seen him eat another flavor) and it was a medium with 3 big scoops of ice cream (even he said it was bigger than he imagined, but better bigger than smaller). For the two cones we only paid $7. Just a heads up, they do take card but you have to spend $10 in order to use it. The young women in the window provided great customer service and I will be returning soon !
Had the chicken or the egg a couple times for lunch. Food is hot, fresh and really good. Staff is super friendly and they have beer  to top it off. Would highly recommend.

Best burger in Nashville. It is the smallest parking lot on the face of the Earth - but I refuse to let that stop me. Its a hole in the wall, seat yourself kind of place - but the servers work together, they are friendly, and they provide great service!

Great little diner! They make tons of dressings/condiments in house and they are the star of the show. 
Ketchup- fresh 
Hot sauce- perfect spice and tang combo
Strawberry jam- I am NOT a jelly or a jam person but I can appreciate when something is delicious.
They also have a ton of others but I just didn't try them to tell you but I have a feeling they would be just as good. Perk- you can buy bottles and pints of all of the stuff! Also want to remark on the fresh squeezed juices!! Orange (amazing!), Grapefruit, apple and lemonade. 

Perfectly cooked eggs. Normally I am 100% team home fries over hash browns but I may be converted after these. Crispy on the outside and paired perfect with the homemade hot sauce. 

Corned beef hash- hash browns that are topped with the corned beef. Was tasty but I wish they were mixed.

Cowboy benedict- would recommend. An eggs benedict  except instead of hollandaise it comes with sausage gravy. 

Will be back for those hash browns and hot sauce!!

Came here after a blisteringly hot bike ride up to Phoenixville from Philly. Very nice staff, decent food, good beer selection. 

They've done the whole social distancing thing well. Menus are on your phone only. There are about 139723429 feet between each table inside and the rest of the seating is outside. All the servers are wearing masks as well. Staff were super nice about serving us, made conversation with us and made us feel at home. 

Big beer menu which was nice. We had the duck nachos. They were..."Avant-garde" as someone at my table said. Unfortunately they were relatively ruined by a thick drizzle of very sweet sauce that really overwhelmed everything else in the dish. I had a simple avocado toast with egg. Goat cheese on top was a nice touch and it was actually pretty good. Also had some margarita pizza. It was fine...nothing to write home about. 

If you're looking for a good safe dining option during COVID with a good beer list, check them out. Food wise...maybe not.
Went here for happy hour on a Monday afternoon. Service was attentive, food was absolutely delicious, and cocktails were great. Overall it was an awesome time. I will definitely be back.

Ok.  I am a Huge Fish taco fan but I actually spit out this taco!  It was not good.   I'm sorry!  I order fish almost everywhere I go and this was Awful.   
They took it off my bill and I got beef quesadilla instead.  That also was not very tasty.   Very salty and did t have a "Fresh" taste.    I go out to eat a few times a week and this is the first time I have felt like I needed to express my opinion about the food!    
On a high note, it has a fun vibe and the margaritas are yummy. The server was very sweet and apologetic!    Will not recommend this for food!

Never have we gotten such a "bums rush" as we did tonight at dinner. We have been going to Opa's since they opened and have always found the service to be great as well as the food. Tonight, however is a different story. We ordered the flaming cheese, lamb dolmas and a gyro salad with extra gyro meat. No more than they served the cheese but immediately came out with everything we ordered. So much for ordering appetizers and expecting a nice casual evening. I give them two stars because the food was good. I give them zero stars for service. It will be some time we go back and when we do, we will order one thing at a time.

We were staying the night near by and needed some dinner. We found this place online and we are so glad we did. This place was AMAZING! 

First of all the customer service was mind blowing. Everyone was so nice and Dani went above and beyond. We got a sampling of everything and the food was seriously so good. We are so sad we are only here for one night which we are sad because we definitely would have eaten here again. Thank you for our great dinner.

Ruby's slipper Cafe is a nice trendy Cafe on Canal St. Let's start with this really nice hostess who was extremely nice and friendly. I wish I would of gotten her name. She sat us at the bar with our server Renee C. She had BAD customer service skills. I think we were ghost sitting in those seats because she barely acknowledged us. I didn't appreciate her giving us the bill when we were in the middle of eating our food. However, the food was extremely good and worth waiting for. Wish we would of had a better server.

Happy Chinese New Year!  I stopped getting buffet and quick Chinese restaurants and just come here. Very friendly and food is delicious. You cannot go wrong with anything you choose here. We come here frequently and it hasn't been upsetting one bit. Family style dinner portions is the best for large groups or take it home to eat it later.

The best pizza and marinara sauce in town!!!
Very friendly and great service with great food.
Really good solid Italian food with great service and by they way they have homemade dessert.  Can't wait to go back.
Most Amazing breakfast food !! Ever!!!!!!!! Breakfast bowls are where it at but. If your feeling crazybtheyre is dessert breakfast cheesecake french toast and more! Mmmmm

Came here with a group of friends and I must say I will likely return. Food took a tad bit longer than expected but our waitress kept us updated and when the food finally came it was delicious. So definitely worth the wait.
This place has absolute ZERO customer service! Wouldn't let me to the elevator to my room because i didn't have my room key and I left my my ID in the room! Completely DISSATISFIED

The best!!! Never had something there that wasn't amazing. Their deli, corned beef, breakfast, soups, etc.  I could go on forever.

It's almost always jammed, but their service is quick, so the wait is typically pretty short.  Everyone there is always working hard.  The quality of food is unwavering. Definitely the only place I get corned beef/Jewish deli in the area. Great for takeout, too.

We were in Reno last week for a Willie Nelson concert, and took the opportunity for a return visit to good old Gas Lamp.  We got there in time for happy hour, and what a change at the bar; the new bartender, whose name I didn't get, is SUCH an improvement over the previous one, and she's a cutie to boot.  She smiles, gives great service, and knows her job.  Then on to dinner.  Our waiter, Bravo, also knows his job, gives great service, has a great sense of humor, and a scraggly "beard".  But the best part was Brenda, the chef, who graciously customized our pasta dinner with her personal attention.  Thanks to all, and you're guaranteed return business from me, from 200 miles away in the SF Bay area. All this personalized attention is something you'll never experience at any of those gigantic hotels in town, and you can park right outside the door, without having to walk 20 minutes just to get inside.  Finally, the concert was a huge disappointment.  Willie speaks the words to his songs, he doesn't sing.
Amazing food! Our server Jen had great customer service. Would definitely visit again and hope to get the same waitress!! Keep up the great job!
Best Chinese food  I have had in three years or maybe ever. Service was spot in on. If I lived in Boise I would come hear every weekend. Super flavorful and super fresh.

Good food.
Nice bacon.
Good cold brew.
Nice choice of music.
Will defiantly go again.

Let me start by saying please don't even waste your time coming here. It was late and our usual go to quick bite spot was closed so we felt adventurous and traveled down the street to Bobs...‍ epic fail. We placed our order, food came swiftly... like too swift...like it was a Swanson microwave meal. Immediately I noticed a stench as if something was rancid. Was it my fried potatoes? After all they were soggy...Nope. My exploding scrambled eggs...nope. It was my French Toast!!! It smelled like curdled milk... barf. I sent it back and like a fool we still finished the rest of our meal. When the check came it was illegible . The waitress had the audacity to try to argue with us and say it cost  DOUBLE the amount,  even after an itemized account from the menu. Her reasoning for the extra $$ tax and the debit card surcharge.... bull crap! This place is a complete rip off... food/service

This is one of my favorite places to go for a quick lunch on a work day.  The salad ingredients are fresh and appealing, and the soups are delicious!  My colleague and I have become regular customers .
Dined in for lunch on a Monday. The dining room was clean, food was delicious, but service a tad slow.
My favorite taco spot in Tampa! Great amazing tasting tacos. Love how authentic they are. Horchata is perfect and those onions they include on the side with every taco, so good!

Visiting from out of town and chose to go to Hog Island based off the reviews. Came in Sunday night around 8p. Restaurant was fairly busy when we were first seated but cleared out  quickly. We were seated right away but took 10 minutes for our waitress to come and greet us. Took another 10 minutes to get lemon and she seemed annoyed we didn't order alcohol. Never introduced herself. Ordered seas food chowder, scallops, and shrimp and grits. Food was good but no where near the description on the menu. Took 15 minutes to finally wave down a server for spoon to even eat our food, but the. It was cold. Scallops were not blackened and barely had any seasoning. Never got a water refill. Meanwhile, all the servers were more concerned about cleaning up and making silverware then people in the restaurant. Would never return and we very disappointed by our experience.

They have a wide range of dishes on their menu. The pizza is great. My favorites are the spicy sausage & calamari and the pasta bolonaise in addition to the pizza the Siciliana said is my wife's favorite. Go and enjoy.

This was my family's go-to Chinese restaurant for years. My last two visits, however, are making me reconsider. My biggest gripe is that the restaurant offers no substitutions at all and will not even try to accommodate a customer request. Not even for a reasonable upcharge. The first visit, I came in to order takeout.  I wanted a chicken and broccoli dinner platter to feed one person. I was told that the only way I could do that was to order each item on the platter separately, which would have been too much food for one person. This was even after I explained that I didn't mind paying an upcharge for the platter. I ended up getting a General Tso's platter. This last visit, I was seated. I ordered another platter for one. This time I requested that the rice be swapped for vegetable lo mein and again stated that I didn't mind an upcharge. The server informed me that I could not get the lo mein unless I paid full menu price for each individual entree. She further stated that I also couldn't get it because it had to be cooked to order (!!!???). I ended up getting a chow mein platter, which had the cooked to order noodles as well as the rice that I didn't want. I think I'm done with this place.

Such a awesome little gem. This place was delicious and the service was amazing!

Food was delicious, our table had the French toast brioche, buttermilk waffles, the southern breakfast, vanilla latte, and bottomless mimosas. All were amazing!! 

Service was outstanding, all of the waiters/waitresses were hustling and I could tell they had a strong work ethic. 

Overall this place was a great choice, and I will definitely be coming back!

Jason and his team at Filipe's have done a nice job throughout the pandemic.   My last visit was especially good.  The food was excellent. I ordered a quesadilla with chorizo. The team members who prepared my order and checked me out were friendly and smiling behind their masks.  I miss their condiment bar but trust it will be back when the normal operations resume.

Love this place the food is always fresh & good, the only down fall is that they close from 2 pm to 5 pm!
Extremely inconvenient!!!

My first time in this particular Publix.  Pros.  Clean, friendly, well lit, no lines.  Cons:  If you drive you park on a separate level and the the elevators are the slowest in the world.  I found one major hole  which I find at most of the Publix:  sugar free Hershey's syrup.  Why is this so hard to keep in stock?  Finally the worst for last.  MR MANAGER:  When my deli person weighed out my meat, much of it directly touched the scale platform, off the plastic sheet!   You need to "edumacate" the women back there that this is totally disgusting!  If it happens again I'm going to have her do my order again!

do not go to this restaurant if you are gluten free!!!!!!! although they have a few gluten free options,they refuse to make any accommodations/substitutions on any plates that have gluten. they also have a rule that if one person does the chef's tasting option, everyone at the table must do the chef's tasting option. because they refuse to accommodate people with gluten allergies with any menu item, this leaves gluten free people with zero options. for a restaurant that was not even half full when we went, it is bold to be so in accommodating and rude. the staff was far from helpful, and this has been one of my least favorite restaurant experiences.

I am so disappointed!  I've ordered from here many times and the food has already been great!  Tonight I ordered for delivery and part of the order was correct, but instead of a burger, I got a chicken sandwich (I don't eat poultry).  Instead of trying to make it right, the man said he'd check with his manager, but I'd have to come get it if approved.  Kind of defeats the delivery idea.

Been coming to taffy's pizza for over 10 years went  food quality ,presentation , in relation to prices has diminished tremendously,  $13 dollars for romaine, chicken, mandarins,  carrots and bean sprouts??? Wheres the pint?? Had hopes for a better place for lunch, but taffy's you're on my Will not go again list ,

From the owners of the Butcher and Barkeep, this place knocks it out of the park. It's a beautiful building located in downtown Souderton. One of the few places that serve alcohol. Due to their license they only serve PA wine, beer, and spirits, but no fear PA makes a lot of good stuff. 
We made a reservation online and due to limited capacity, they are limited table times.  We were a table of 3 and had a 90 minute time limit. We were seated in the bar area. Noise levels are moderate, but not too noisy. 

I looked at the craft cocktail menu, unfortunately nothing appealed to me. There were a few bourbon/rye drinks, which like, but didn't give me the summer vibes. However, their wine selection was great.  I ordered the sparkling wine from Pinnacle Ridge. 

I ordered the mahi mahi and asked if I could sub the rice for asparagus. They did for a $3 upcharge. I thought that was a bit spendy, but ordered it. The meal was outstanding. Perfectly cooked and well seasoned. If you have a larger appetite it may be a bit small, so order an appetizer or salad. But it was perfection for me. My husband had the salmon and I had a bite, fantastic. 

My FIL ordered the fried chicken sandwich and gobbled it right up. He also ordered dessert, which looked like a chocolate mousse. He loved it. 

Overall a great light meal accompanied by wonderful service. Looking forward to our next visit.

I've been going to 3Crow since it opened in 2004. We've celebrated engagements and birthdays here, it was our favorite after work bar in the city. The staff was like family. Then, they were gone. People who have worked here for ages, who made the place what it was, who literally helped management rebuild after the tornado just...gone. Don't go here, they treated their loyal staff badly, there are lots of bars in the city you should pick another.

We were happy with our takeout on a Sunday afternoon.  I can say it was quite busy and we had to wait an additional 20 mins ok top of our 30 min wait time.  All good, I'd rather see these establishments making money during these times.

Prices are good, as comparable as some of the other seafood shacks in the area. I don't know that the quality of the seafood is as high as some big name restaurants but non the less very tasty and flavorful.

This is a must visit.  Food is absolutely delicious.  Breakfast is not your normal breakfast, everything has a lot of mix flavors.  They have unlimited sangria or mimosas for $12, Sangria was so delicious.  Owner was there and is very attentive, even tried a new recipe for us.  Love the concept and the food was delicious.
I like their food. I used to always get the turkey burger deluxe but unfortunately they no longer carry turkey burgers

After walking by this place countless times, my wife and I finally gave it a try. The anticuchos de corazón were excellent! By far our favorite dish that we tried and on par with some of the best we've had in Peru. The shrimp ceviche was also very good, but lacked a punch so the waiter brought out some much needed aji limo which was great. Not so great was the fact those tiny guys cost me an extra $3 (surprise!). The tiraditos and ceviche nikkei were both decent, my wife ordered the causa and I'm still not a fan (pre-existing condition). Overall, a very good meal and would return for their anticuchos and to give a spicier ceviche a try.

I've lived in Medford my whole life and always remember coming to Ott's as a kid. I've heard some live music before and definitely remember loving their loaded tater tots! 

I'm basing this review solely on a visit I had a few months ago. I went on a double date when it was still warm enough to eat outside. We were seated far from others and it felt very safe. We got a menu but also were able to scan for a menu. There were so many options I didn't know what to choose! 

I ended up going with a salmon caesar salad which was delicious! My girlfriend got buffalo chicken salad and the bay fries. My boyfriend got wings and our other friend got a burger. No one had any complaints with the food!!

The service was nice and quick and we enjoyed our meal! We were close enough to the bar to be able to look over to the TV's as well.

Like I said, this was months ago, so I'm unsure of how they are doing with indoor dining. Overall, loved the meal and will be back soon!
Excellent tapas, good drinks, and a warm atmosphere. The tapas were flavorful and delicious. I wish we could come back for entrees. Drinks well prepared and not overpowering.

Great little Italian place. Doesn't look like much from outside but definitely one of the best in Tampa Bay. Waiter was very friendly and knowledgeable. Food presentation was beautiful as well as very flavorful. Steak was very tender. Bread and oil given was interesting as the oil was mixed with peppers, olives, and hummus.

Cavan is the perfect neighborhood spot. They have an amazing, dedicated staff who are always friendly and knowledgeable. The food is seasonal and delicious. Tegan was a wonderful server who was super attentive and enthusiastic.

We came on a Sunday afternoon. It was about a 30 minute wait for our party of 6 which wasn't bad as the restaurant is in the mall. Our drinks take a lil longer than expected but our server seemed the be in the weeds so we just munched on bread until they came. I ordered the chicken and shrimp gumbo. I was a little worried because the chef decorated my plate with parsley however it was phenomenal. I would definitely recommend you visit the Cheesecake Factory.

Now I love Indian food, but this here is definitely some of the BEST Indian food I've ever had! I had the Chana Masala. It's hard to mess up that dish, but their's is perfect! The portions are generous, the pricing is reasonable, and the service was very attentive. They treat you like family. I highly recommend. Definitely have to bring my family here. PS if you feel like your life lacks seasoning, go get your life at Curry Leaves!

Went for a drink and quick bite before leaving on a flight and the head bartender in the cafe area must have been in some kind of horrible mood. I asked a question about an item on the menu and he took it totally personally like I was insulting the restaurant. When I apologized to him for any miscommunication, he obnoxiously and with a snide tone said, "it's ok, I'm just going to make sure your food come out really slowly." Really?! What a jerk. I immediately asked to close my tab, leisurely drank my glass of wine and left. It was such a dumb situation to escalate the way it did. I feel ridiculous even writing this down, but I'm just so flabbergasted. Hey bartender, calm down dude! Don't take yourself so seriously!

The BEST ice cream I have ever had. The flavors are pure and rich. We got a pint that was half cookies and cream and half pistachio. In the picture attached, you'll see the top - pistachio. Sure, this place may be a little pricier than your average Ben & Jerrys. But it is vegan, local, and the employees are so nice! Cant wait to go back to try another treat.

Came here for a late night dinner. 
The place was busy but our wait wasn't too long, under 20 minutes. We ordered the caesar salad, mac n cheese, a salmon dish and a catfish sandwich. The catfish sandwich was good and so was the salmon. The mac n cheese wasn't bad per se, but to me it tasted too much like butter or cream and the caesar salad was good, it seemed to have some spice/heat to it. Overall the place was nice, everyone was friendly. We did wait a bit longer than average to get any of our food out, but it was super busy.
They have the best churros I have ever tasted! Large selection with great customer service. Low prices and good quality!

This restaurant will be providing a venue for Donald Trump Jr ( Trump/ Pence 2020 campaign) on Friday 10/16/20. Needless to say, providing a venue for this campaign of hate, racism, division and governmental ineptitude - makes for a horrific dining experience. Given the lack of health and safety protocols at prior events of this campaign, its clear COVID is a joke to anyone who hosts these people. I used to bring family and friends visiting from out of town to this spot. Never again.

Great menu, comfortable dining areas, pricing is nice, big screens with the games and service is pretty fast. Food is well prepared, perhaps a little over-seasoned, but not out of line. A nice oasis in a dodgy neighborhood, but the clientele are an upstanding mix and everybody seems happy. We got in late, right before closing, but everything was done right and only the waitresses insistence to close the check and leave it with us was our only indication they were itching to turn out the lights and head home. Worthy of another visit next time in town.

Personally I loved everything I ordered! My husband enjoyed the meal but didn't love it. 

We got the lunch special which was 11 bucks and got 3 tacos and a chopped salad. 

Tacos

Miso cod: amazing! Perfect Asian taco! Cod was cooked perfectly too.

Baja: again cod, but fried with slaw. Delish.

Chicken chorizo: very spicy in a good way, but not my favorite. 

I got all mine on lettuce to be healthy and I was still full! The salad was the perfect amount and packed with flavor. Cheeses, sliced beets, tortillas and vinaigrette. Awesome! 
Wish my whole party
The food is delicious. And despite waiting on a packed house the service is good.

Terrible customer service, very unfriendly, especially the young Latino boy usually working the register; seems annoyed to be taking anyone's order. Seen him several times before. He seems like he's been working there for a while and hates his job. I wish there was another Taco Bell in town, because it's always so awkward going into this taco bell to order. A team's only as strong as their weakest leak; this guys effort and customer service is WEAK! Wish I knew his name, usually ruins my Taco Bell experience
Great experience at Pop's! The food was good and the service was great. It was very clean and it was super busy too which is always a good sign. Can't wait to go back and take my husband!

This place is so good, wow. I was picking up pizza and decided to look at their website while waiting. Well one of the rolls looked good- but didn't have a name. I had to go up to see what it was. I didn't see the sign to wait outside, so I walked in like a doofus, but they were nice after asking me to wait outside. Everyone had masks and it looked like they were really being careful which I appreciate. 

I completely forgot the name of the roll but it's the one with the quail egg on top and it's *to die for* (I'll put their site pic up). Dietary restrictions (not allergy) prevent me from eating rice and this place has a few no-rice options. This roll either didn't have rice or they made it without for me (I get chatty when I'm nervous and I have social anxiety so my short term memory short-circuits)- the waiter was super nice and so was the waitress who came out to check on me when it looked like they were a bit busy and I had been waiting some. 

This spot is a 20-ish minute drive from us but worth it. I definitely plan to go again.

My husband and I were going to celebrate our 50th wedding anniversary and were looking for a new place to have dinner. We heard so many good reviews about Anthony's Chophouse in the Sparks Nugget. We were lucky to get a reservation due to a cancellation. The wine list, which I looked, over was over priced. There was a $25 corkage fee since we brought our own wine. The menu is a la carte which means nothing comes with the entree. We had Escargot and my husband had Lobster Bisque that was very salty and I had the Burrata Heirloom salad which was a tomato quartered with the cheese on bread with a balsamic drizzle. My husband ordered the Veal Chop Parmesan, which was very good. I had the 8 oz. Australian Lobster Tail which was way overpriced at $60! Our sides, green beans and roasted brussel sprouts were so under cooked they were crunchy. In my personal opinion, I do not recommend this restaurant as it is way over priced and overrated. I would highly recommend the Steakhouse at Western Village.
Excellent food and service for brunch.  Amazing craft cocktails.  Convenient location.  Highly recommend.

double check your food before you drive off. today, is the second time i've regrettably left and went home and found out they forgot one of my items. my steak was not well done as i strongly requested. such a waste of time and money. 

the first time, i called and was told i'll get a partial refund within 3-5 business days. sadly, it's been a month and still no refund. i won't be returning to this location.
Oh what a difference from every other pizza we have had in Tucson. We took 3 years before we tried it. Do not make the same mistake.
I loved this place and I'm so sorry to see it close. Many memories, staff outings, when asked, this was the place they wanted.

The cake is good.  It's not amazing.  It's better then anything you'll get at a store but if you roam outside of Chester County you'll certainly find much better (I.e Clays).  

The customer service is horrible.  It's like dumb cop / bad cop most days.  The person at the front is clueless and runs to the back to talk to someone who has an attitude and likes to talk loud.  

I've experience this twice and walked out.  They just not worth with my time.  I've had their  cakes before at other parties, and like I mentioned, it's decent.
Chicken wings that you have to chew on are not good wings. French fries so hard I chipped my tooth and onion rings that were burnt. Never again !!!!!
Great service, quality food, and a good value.  The staff is always friendly and helpful, and the food is a unique, tasty option for Nashville.

I have heard about this place for years but never tried it until recently. I was very impressed the first time so I brought my husband to try it for my second time.
Both times the food was outstanding! So good and the portions are plenty! 
They have a large menu with many options for all different types of food. They even have a large selection of "healthier" dishes. 
We of course tried the pizookies and those too are amazing  
The service, wait time, and menu options are great. We will definitely be back next time we are looking to go out. 
Easy 5 star.
this pizza is the bomb..whole family loved it and better than any pizza we can get at home by a mile.   we will absolutely be back

Food was amazingly good. I had the brisket and brussel sprouts. It was smacking! The staff was very friendly and the layout looks like it's going to be a fun spot to hang out. The ping pong and axe throwing wasn't open just yet. I'm here this week for work, so u fortunately I am not going to get to enjoy that part. But the food and service was well worth it! Good luck Base Camp on your grand opening.

One of the best Indian restaurants I have eaten at. The Naan was amazing and the mussels appetizer is to die for (curry sauce is amazing) I will definitely try this place again next time I am in town.

This place is so unsanitary the bathrooms have poop stains everywhere, the service is terrible, and they got tons of stuff wrong, they don't even bring you the same drink on refills. This place sucks!!!

This buffet has a very WIDE selection of items. They have so many different kinds of sushi, hibachi, Chinese food, and dessert too (different flavors of ice cream, tiramisu cake, fruit, etc.). Its also very cheap. Their sushi isn't amazing or anything but I mean for the price you're paying for what do you expect. The hibachi, however, is pretty decent. It's a good place if you want to stuff yourself and not pay much.

I have had my fair share of my Cajun and creole food. This was not quite there. It had flavors of red beans and rice but the beans were undercooked and the after taste just didn't appeal to me. The roast beef Po boy tasted like roast beef was warmed in the microwave. Two thumbs up for the service as spot on and friendly.
Best bread in FL. You want authentic Cuban bread there's no better place to go. Only bread I use at home and for my restaurant.

Walking in at 7:00pm to an empty dining room should have been a red flag. The appetizers were greasy. The meatballs tasted like the needed to be cooked longer. As for the entrees: 
- Spaghetti Carbonara: we ordered 2 and both just tasted like the pasta water it was cooked in. The flavors were not married together. 
- Lobster Ravioli with Shrimp: the ravioli tasted old and chewy and the shrimp had a strong fishy taste. 
- Stuffed shells: was the special of the day; nothing to write home about. 
- Veggie Lasagne: also, meh. 

We accidentally broke a glass with club soda and we cleaned it up ourselves since we could not locate our server for most of the meal. She then charged us to replace the club soda! 

The service was not great and the food followed suit. Disappointing birthday meal.

Not only are these the best sandwiches and steaks in the area, but the employees are amazing. Great on the phone when they take your order and so pleasant when you arrive to pick it up. My #1 go to for takeout!

There is no where in Franklin, and I repeat nowhere, that makes a margarita as good as Pueblo Real!   The restaurant itself is getting pretty popular, so it's harder and harder to get a table. But the food is good!

The guy making pizza is in the worst mood at all Times and it shows in the quality of the pizza. Extremely light with a thick layer of grease for $4 per slice. Expect to hear about how much of a bad mood the guy making pizza is. Will not go there again. Horrible experience.

I could eat Rick's Preferred Wings every day, especially with the sweet chili sauce for dipping. I would normally think of any salad called a "Garden Salad" would be basic and bland.  But Vitos garden salad is a tasty meal in and of itself. The toasted ravioli are awesome and the Monster pizza is excellent. I haven't had anything that I didnt really like.

The trend for Mexican food in Mount Juliet is definitely middle of the road. With exception of a few, it all just seems ok. 

We got our food to go and they seem to be following all COVID guidelines. Masks on servers, the bar is fully closed and hand sanitizers are all over the venue. 

I had major food envy for my wife's meal, her's was way better than mine. The tamale, the enchilada, all the flavors were there. I especially liked the mole sauce that came with her order. For starters, my burrito was ice cold. Maybe it sat around for too long? I order the burrito Mexicana with pork, it was huge and loaded with tomatoes, lettuce, rice and cheese. It was also covered in red sauce and sour cream, which could be one reason why it was cold when I got it. Although huge, this burrito was just ok. There was no real flavor spice at all, I don't even think meat was even marinated.

This place is close by, so I could see us coming here again maybe, but not for a while. Sorry, Don Pancho.
I swear Kingston 11  is da best very satisfied with everything I get to eat from they best Jamaicans out

They messed up my order and put cheese and spicy sauce all over my tacos when I didn't order it. I don't eat dairy so I wasn't happy at all. And then when I took all the cheese off to try and not waste the food I had I found a hair in my food. Not cool. Not happy. Completely ruined my food.

Today at 2:00 p.m. we were 4th in line.  The 1st car at the order board took 6 minutes.  The next car surpassed NINE minutes waiting to order when we pulled out of the line and left.  The 1st car was STILL at the pickup window.  No excuse for a fast food business.  Am sure they deservedly lost a lot of business.  Do not literally waste your time at this location.

It was our same foodie group as usual. The place was very cozy inside, and located in a great place. 
Friend #1 said the pasta was not cooked enough, and the smoke Sausage overpowered the taste.
Friend #2 said the ribs were Average, but the fries were the best.
Friend #3 said her food was great. She had the redfish with grit cakes. She  said the grit cake was very light, and the  redfish was very tasty.
Friend #4 said his shrimp and grits was the best he's had in a long time. The shrimp was seasoned good, and the grits were creamy.
My steak was tender, flavorful, and good. I'll tell you this I love I mean absolutely love fries ever since  I was a little girl. It was something about those fries that was different in the very best way. 
This place was given 3 stars because it wasn't on our top end of places we've tried.

I would give this place a 1 for food. Salad was bland and didn't taste fresh. The kitchen forgot the dressing and it took almost 5 minutes for our waiter to bring us a side. The bratwurst had no flavor but for the taste of burnt onions. The kitchen also forgot the mustard. Great selection of beer and if we returned it would only be for a drink.
Great pastas and t ravs. Pretty casual and affordable maybe compared to other places on the hill. We like to sit in the bar area.

Delicious, fun, and different! The blending of flavors is unique and well done. Many many sauces to choose from, allowing tweaking towards a more Mexican or more Asian direction. Totally a little hole in the wall, but clean and charming. I highly recommend for those looking to shake things up a bit!

Tried three bathrooms. Not one bathroom had soap in the dispenser. Told several staff, and they said thanks, yet seemed indifferent about it and went about their jobs. Lots of patrons in and out of the bathrooms, yet nobody seemed phased by this. Great rooftop bar. Would never go back though.

The food is always good. The service is good if you are ordering there. If you place an online order the service is terrible. The first time we did an online order it wasn't even started when I went to pick it up. I got there 15 minutes after it was supposed to be done. When they finished it, they just gave me the bag. No apology, or thank you. And the order was wrong. This time picking up another order the girl gave me the bag and walked away. No greeting, no thank you. I get the feeling they don't like online orders

I had to write a review for one of my favorite local taco spots. I have been going to Paco's for a few years now and have never left unsatisfied with a meal. The staff is friendly and quick with getting orders in, which I love especially when placing an order to-go. I recently found out they are on Total Takeout and Doordash so I'll have to try that out soon. 

Paco's Taqueria has a small parking lot right off Keystone but the inside décor is fun and lively. They have been working on painting their walls over the years with colorful, hand drawn images and designs. I think this adds to the local and authentic atmosphere of the restaurant. 

This time I decided to get the carne asada tacos. I love that their tacos come with cilantro and onions and then customers have the option to add more ingredients if they choose. I always add the pico de gallo and a side of their queso, which is the white runny kind that I know a lot of people love. I also added cheese, sour cream, salsa, and a side of guacamole to my tacos. Paco's has a few different kinds of salsa that vary in heat and taste, but they are all delicious. The freshness of the ingredients is apparent after taking the first bite! 

 I have noticed that the prices of Paco's tacos are slightly hirer than some of their competitors, but I believe this speaks to the quality of the food. I would rather pay a couple extra dollars for amazing food at a local spot than settle for less at another establishment. Any time my friends retu

What a difficult time to celebrate the holidays... we decided to splurge and order dinner from Bouchon... we were overwhelmed by how good it was that we called the restaurant to tell them: we said we'd yelp it but wanted to let them know that it was A+. Highly recommend them for dinners to go while we are in lockdown. So many of the dinners we've ordered from other restaurants were just so so but this is as good as if we were at Bouchon.
Lauren was the best waitress we've ever had. She's very pleasant and always nice. Food tastes good aswell!

I've been to "The Boiling House" in cherry hill several times and on my last visit, they mentioned they had another location in philly called The Boiling pot. The food is the same, delicious as always! I enjoyed the space and ambiance of this location. They have a bar, but when we went, they didn't have their liquor license yet. So, I look forward to coming back once they're fully up and running. It's a new restaurant, so it's perfectly clean and beautiful. There's limited meter parking out front. We were staying at a nearby hotel, so we took an Uber to and from the restaurant. If you are a seafood lover, this is the place for you!

Ordered two large pizzas, cheese fries and mozzarella sticks for takeout on a Saturday night. It was ready for pickup within 20 minutes and was still hot when we got it home.

The pizza was good. Nothing too special. More on the plain tomato-y side when it comes to flavor. Also not too crispy... falls when you try to pick it up.

The cheese fries were yummy, reminded me more of a beer cheese! The mozzarella sticks were nice and crisp.

So here's the good: service was prompt. Inna was amazing. Super friendly and on point. 

Here's the meh: the food itself is underwhelming. There's so many better places to go. 

For what it's worth, the kitchen and server were understaffed. Inna was the only one working the floor and she did a stellar job.

This is my first time ordering from the Noble Pie and at first I loved it! I loved the variety of different toppings and the pizza tasted amazing, especially the BBQ chicken pizza. Although, our Ring of Fire had several small hairs in it  I wish we saw it before we were half way through the dish

Best Chicken Mole on EARTH.

Try it with the whole beans x flour tortillas.

From there, copy/paste/post this review.

Go!

Pretty sure I went to Red's on the same night as someone complaining down below...and tbh heard a lot of what happened. For starters, Red's is FAMILY style dining. They emphasize this OVER and OVER and OVER again. And in case you forget, it says it on the menu and then the server mentions it to you AGAIN. So if you want your food to come out all at once, you may not enjoy this (especially if you're a large party that wants all your entrees all at the same time.) They emphasize this A LOT which is why they also encourage sharing their large plates, because yet AGAIN, it's family style dining that rolls food out a few plates at a time. We came with a group of about 6 and were seated outside after a 45 minute wait. We chose to wait because we REALLY wanted to try this place and understood there would be a wait (it was a Friday night AND Chinese New Year after all). 

Anyway, we had a great time. We knew it was family style dining, so we ordered accordingly and were totally fine with our food rolling out one entree after the other. Our waiter was really patient and really kind, despite the table next to us being beyond rude because they apparently didn't heed the "Chinese New Year + Family Style dining" warning (that they make SURE to give you multiple times when you walk through the door). Our waiter was a sweet redheaded guy with stylish lil boots, and we made sure to try and be patient and extra understanding in an effort to make up for the crotchety crew next to us that even

I've been here a good amount of times for sushi and each time was progressively worse than the time before. The one time I had their hibachi it was ridiculously salty. Come to think of it this places was never all that when it came to sushi but I still stopped in from time to time because I live near by and it was convenient. Tonight will probably be my last visit since there are MANY much better places for sushi. 

For starters their fish did not seem to be properly refrigerated. That's probably since the area where they keep the fish is right next to the hibachi grill. Just the look and touch of the glass where they display the fish, you can tell that it's not cold. I felt uncomfortable eating the sushi. Obviously it didn't taste good. I also left smelling like stir fried food.

Great location but disappointing food.  I've tried it a couple of times in the hopes that they would step it up, but flavors, presentation, and creativity were disappointing. A glass of wine or beer outside is probably terrific.
Salt and Smoke is by far the best BBQ restaurant I've been to. As a fan of BBQ, I don't say this lightly. The Mac and Cheese is wonderful, the Brisket is perfect, and the sauces were mind-blowing.

Hubby and I made our first trip to Capital Tacos last night.  We are hunting down Mexican-type eateries and this one has a great rating.  We were a little green figuring out the menu board, but we picked a winner and enjoyed our meal.  We decided on MOPAC nachos, and tried the queso because it has been mentioned many times as delicious.  All the food was delicious and we ate until we could eat no more!  We wouldn't have needed the queso sauce...there was enough juicy flavor on the chips and all were covered, so didn't have plain ones for dipping.  We couldn't have eaten any more, so it's a work in progress to figure out all the combinations that will work for us. 

Everyone was so nice and helpful!  They all had smiles on their faces, the place was clean, and steady but not crowded.  One of the soda pop flavors was out, I mentioned to one of the girls and she fixed it ASAP.  The parking lot is a little tight but we did park out front.  I can imagine at certain times it could be challenging.  But don't let that prevent you from getting in there! 

We are definitely going to return.  I've got my eye on a bowl and hubby on a salad.  We already know if we get a burrito we will split it!  Great experience, always nice to feel happy with your decision for dinner, especially when you risk a new place.
Such a fun cafe with amazing coffee and awesome food!! Will be back! Great location, great service, great place!

It was busy so I shouldn't have been surprised with the lack of good service. Our server would leave in the midfle of taking our drink/ food orders). Extremely loud and fast paced, no you better know what you want. Hopefully you don't care to spend whatever price they think of that day because a lot of the prices are listed as "varies".

I took my family to Rumba Island Bar & Grill Monday, January 25, 2021 @ 7:15ish. We sat outside...  complimentary muffins came out. Over baked and dry. Shit happens. Four people ordered the 'special'. Sea bass, crab cake, shrimp & crab Mac 'n cheese. I had salmon. My daughter offered me to try some of her dinner. Just saying I wasn't impressed. Crab cake in particular tasted 'off'. Unbeknownst to each other until next morning we had ALL GOTTEN SICK. Me the least having just sampled the food. The rest... without too much detail...  a LOT of TP was used. Manager did offer a 'redo' meal but needless to say...  Thanks but no thanks. Disappointed. I used to enjoy this restaurant. Just a heads up.
had a wonderful experience at the drive-through, the attendant was so sexy and funny. haven't eaten the food yet so I'm not sure how it actually is, the five stars is for the service

Really great food and prices. There tacos are great and my wife loves the pork one. The margaritas are good and the draft beer selection is ok. You can also just go old school with a PBR always on draft.

Dinner was delicious!! Our waitress was so kind and patient as I kept asking for samples - my food had a suggested pairing  and I normally don't like Chardonnay (newsflash: still don't) but I wanted to give it a try. I ended up with a glass of Pinot Gris as we ate our appetizer of drunken shrimp (oh holy cow delicious!!) my husband ordered the steak medallions with toppings and I had the barramundi in lemongrass sauce. The rice was a little disappointing (looks like preformed sticky rice that you can microwave) but the fish was cooked perfectly and the sauce - oh man, I could have licked my plate!!

We finished with the lemon ice wine cheesecake. I wish I hadn't volunteered to share - it was soooo good!!

I'm a sales rep who has used this company twice for a doctor's office who loved their food. Typically, I'd think nothing of it and order without question. However, after 2 experiences with them now, I am done using Hymie's. My first lunch was 45 minutes late. I gave them a 30 minute buffer and they still blew by that. The scheduler who messed up the schedule offered nothing but a "hope everything is fantastic" text. I asked about a discount and got no response. I had to call and hunt someone down to get that offer. 

The 2nd time around I placed an order I just consistently got attitude for every single thing I said over the phone. "Can you check it my card is on file?" Attitude. You'd think I asked them to pay my bill on their dime with the response I got. And "can you include a salad and cookie tray for the order?" Attitude. It's ridiculous. A bunch of miserable people working at this place. I'm not holding my breath for this next order to be on time either - time will tell. 

Avoid. Zero customer service. Bare bones minimal work done here.

With all the businesses having limited dining opportunities, I chose to come here with my other half. This restaurant has stayed open and I appreciate all they've done to keep the place extra clean and safe for customers. I truly have only good things to report. The waitstaff were absolutely wonderful and attentive. The facility was clean and the atmosphere was easy.

We shared two dishes: one was the tamale cakes, and the other was the Thai lettuce wraps. Both were absolutely delicious. The tamale cakes were flavorful and came with a creamy, spicy, herbaceous sauce that added a punch of flavor. Since we are plant-based, we had the Thai lettuce wraps with avocado in place of chicken. The portion was more than enough for two of us to share. It had three different sauces. One was a cilantro herb sauce, one a peanut hoisin sauce, and the last one was a sesame seeds soy sauce. 

What brought down the stars are the tamale cakes could have been crispier; and the sauces for the lettuce wraps were overly salty and sweet. But a little bit does go along way. And it was good to be out and feel like we were being taken care of.

Our palates were treated to variety.

Have had this a couple times and it's pretty good. It's very pricy, though, and probably not the best quality meat. Their loaded fries and bbq tacos were pretty delicious but left my stomach a bit unsettled.

Always excited for new Italian eateries in town, and this new spot in the CBD did not disappoint. Decor is cool, but not over the top. Weird unicorn is...weird. Friendly, attention staff. At first I was a bit thrown by the structure of the menu, but once we realized it's sort of sharing/several-course situation, we were set. Server helped in the regard as well. Meatballs are traditional (and great), lazagnetta is definitely more on the modern side (also excellent) and the tartufo was the cherry on top (no actual cherries involved). One small thing I noticed was when our server got slammed by a large party - and we waiting to pay the bill - another member of the staff slid in and collected payment. Little things like that really are really appreciated.

The food is really good here and the people are very nice. However , I think for the portions that you get is a bit expensive.  But if you're craving catfish this is definitely the place to go. It is so good. The fried chicken its good but I've had better from a couple places like blue sky café in Highland and Eckerts in Belleville.  But the car is pretty cool I like it. I also like that I could eat here during Covid when others weren't open. My food is definitely cooked order order and very fresh. Just bring your wallet. I am a foodie & I'm completely going to try out again but maybe try and get specials to save a buck
Food was delicious and cheap. Service was good and the place was clean. I highly recommend this place.

After clearing numerous tables so the bartender could continue making drinks for all the customers and help expedite services.  A rude woman with a group of gay individuals called me a f****** weirdo for jumping in and helping out. This place seemed nice and the staff was very friendly  this one woman was quite rude.
Exciting tasty alternative to the usual fast food. Stop going to the usual burger joints and go here instead! I highly recommend the kimchi burritos and tacos.

There are a few El Charros in Tucson but this one is the best. I love the food, the ambiance and the house margarita is good. 
Ian was one of the best servers I have had anywhere in awhile. We never wanted for anything. He was attentive and even greeted me at the door when the hostess was busy. We will be back of course.
Good if you have a lot of time.  The hipster employees are not going to hurry.  Very nice view and great place to sit outside.
The food was great and the waiters were helpful and kind, especially Sean. He made us all feel welcome and made us all laugh. Highly recommend!

It's the best restaurant near the mall!  Just go and you won't be disappointed. Fantastic food, friendly and prompt services, nice open and happy atmosphere. They are very accommodating to my two years old toddler. We will definitely go back.

The drinks were all superb. I mean above and beyond. I really enjoyed some of the unique offerings on their menu. The food was..okay. It was more of a tapas menu that was offered and nothing really stood out. Especially not for the pricing and portion. For example I ordered the octopus that was maybe around the $15 mark and I received one small, thin, 3in. tentacle and it was ...ok. I've had far better, this was my least favorite. But nothing else we ordered would incite me to return which is a bummer as I heard wonderful hype about this place. It's possible they weren't offering their normal menu because of covid things? But the service was just ok as well. Overall a high bill for small amounts of mediocre food. 5 stars for drinks, maybe a 2 for the dining. Bummer

This is still a regular spot of ours and we're so glad they're open again for dine-in and have ample patio seating!  We headed there for Taco Tuesday specials.  Cassidy, our server, was super friendly and attentive and even recognized us from a previous visit. Overall she made our dinner a great experience. She had some great menu suggestions and introduced us to the new margarita flavors they just started offering!  

There are a few new tacos on the menu and the Carne Asada Vampire was an instant favorite for our whole table! We also shared the queso fundido appetizer with mushrooms.  It's served in a hot iron skillet alongside warm tortillas.  The cheese is deliciously melty and the marinated mushrooms are the perfect umami compliment.  Really, you can't go wrong with anything on the menu alongside a pitcher of the margaritas!

Michael the gentleman who check us in was very helpful and friendly!  He answered all our questions.  During Covid, the complementary shuttles run until 10pm, Mon-Sun.  The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. The location of the hotel is close to everything. Five minutes to Hatty B's Chicken, one of the famous food spots here in Nashville. Tavern was also delicious and that was across the street from Hatty. Highly recommend this hotel!

Took my husband here for his birthday. Thank goodness we made a reservation. This place gets pretty packed on the weekend. Well we were seated in a corner, which was fine. The tables for two are pretty large. As soon as we were seated, we were offered water followed by yummy cheese bread. All of our waiters were very attentive in the beginning. I stuck with a water and my husband ordered a cocktail (which took a while to be delivered). We started off at the buffet which offered a wide variety of hot and cold selections. The soup of the day was lobster bisque which was pretty delicious. My husband enjoyed the rice from the buffet area as well as the smoked salmon. It was pretty tasty! I loved the salad options, the shrimp, and the greens beans. Once we arrived at our table, we flipped our cards from red (stop) to green (go) and the meat started to flow in. We were offered all types of delicious cuts of beef, pork, chicken, seafood, and one of the best garlic breads I have ever had. The meats except for the filet mignon were juicy and well seasoned (full of flavor). The filet mignon was dry (hahah my only complaint). The table sides offered included garlic mash potatoes and plantains which were both delicious . The only down side was that towards the end of our meal my water sat empty for a while. Also, once we finally received our bill, it took forever for someone to collect it. Luckily, I paid in cash so I didn't have to wait for them to return.  Word of advice: don't neglect

I absolutely love Wayback Burgers! Every time I get one I am transported. My mouth is watering just thinking about their food. I usually get the Classic, but you can't go wrong with any choice. And the fries, Mac and cheese bites and the onion rings and the chips! Milkshakes too. Yum!!!

I would give this place a five for effort and creativity as well as service but the food was more of a 3.5. They overdid it with ingredients instead of focusing on taste and flavor. The cocktails were the same. My husband loves beer and said it was "good" and took some home.  We ordered several different salads and found the tuna salad to be too dry. The Nashville boneless chicken strips were a little too spicy to be considered mild but I enjoyed them. The buffalo cauliflower was incredibly good. The fish and chips were tasty but the salmon salad was dry.  The Buffalo chicken dip was really good and was served with chips and celery sticks. It was very cheesy so that was a nice surprise. The pretzel with the beer dip was also great. I forgot to take pictures before we all dove into our dishes.   Hands-down this local place is a win compared to any other chain you might consider going to. It's important to support local and small businesses!
